* Reinstated Totem API
* Supports WoW Tokens in China

model_review.cause: Actual host-supplied slots and time expiry exist; stale security comment is not model evidence. Current Era lifecycle measured separately. Page declares no historical signature/default/targeting or time-left contract; GetTotemTimeLeft and TargetTotem lack exact-name owned source matches. No invented wrappers.

Existing generic token commerce state and store workaround are not China regional activation/payment/native behavior. HasPurchaseableProducts is not DoesGroupHavePurchaseableProducts; no alias/foreign member credit. Page specifies no purchase policy/default/signature.
Existing summon_request readers do not register ConfirmSummon. Page lacks arguments, accept/decline state transitions and event effects; no fabricated confirmation lifecycle.

model_review.area: Commentator / war games / fixed timestep / instance lock
model_review.cause: Exact/bare current source scan finds no callable implementations for these page names. No participants/team selection, lock encounter timer, request/response lifecycle or fixed-timestep query contract in literal page. Factory presence would not prove models.
Names appear in event catalog; permissive Classic registration is nondiscriminating. Producer, payload, delivery order and state transitions unspecified by page; no synthetic dispatch credit.
No exact-name owned src match. Literal source gives no default, scope, selection/color mapping or update contract. Unrelated CVar roundtrip/default is not nameplate color model proof.
